rationale: The canonical mode contract maps an approved-UR delivery whose completed Brownfield Review persisted quick_task to the human-facing Compact Delivery path.
decision_grounds: A durable UR is explicitly approved.
The stored quick_task context is explicitly recorded as the Mode/Slice Decision.
The modes contract requires the compact_delivery label when approved UR, completed Brownfield analysis, and stored quick
The task is bounded to exposing the Claude Run Status Card through existing hook and contract-owner paths, consistent
Missing-evidence fail-closed does not apply because all three Compact Delivery prerequisites are supplied.
